temporal_cutoff.description: Deprecated alias for published_before; supplying both with different values is rejected.

result_type.description: core (default) returns abstracts; lite is metadata-only. include_abstracts=true coerces lite up to core.

include_abstracts.description: When true, abstract snippets are populated on top_records (requires result_type=core; coerced automatically).

max_query_terms.description: Upper bound on tokens after query normalization; LLM-authored multi-concept queries are truncated to this many terms.

fetch_text_mined_terms.description: When true, calls Europe PMC's annotations API for records flagged hasTextMinedTerms=Y and populates constraint_evidence + text_mined_annotations.
